steps.tapQuarters: First just the rhythm, written on a single line: tap any key with each note. Quarter notes get one click, half notes two.
steps.beats: Music moves to a steady beat, like the metronome’s click. A quarter note lasts one beat. A half note lasts two beats: keep the key down for both clicks.
steps.quartersAndHalves: Play along with the metronome. The short bars are quarter notes; the longer ones are half notes.
steps.mixed: Now quarter and half notes mixed together.
